job.title: Backend Developer Onlineshop & dm-App - Java / Kotlin (w/m/d)

tailoring.headline: Backend Developer | Java, Spring Boot & REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker, Kubernetes and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

cover_en.subject: Application: Backend Developer Onlineshop & dm-App - Java / Kotlin (w/m/d)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Backend Developer Onlineshop & dm-App position at dmTECH GmbH in Karlsruhe. With over 5 years of professional experience as a backend developer building enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and microservices.

bullets.label: Backend Services & APIs
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, developing and exposing OCC REST Web Services and custom data flows.

bullets.label: Product Data Processing
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: System Performance & CI/CD
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed, and executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2).

bullets.label: Agile Collaboration
bullets.text: Collaborated within agile DevOps workflows, performed code reviews, supported production issues, and worked closely with international technical teams.

cover_en.gap: While my primary backend expertise is rooted in Java and Spring Boot rather than Kotlin, and my German language proficiency is at the B1 level rather than C1, I am very keen to learn Kotlin and further develop my skills to support your team effectively.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, making me available to start on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application with you.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at dmTECH because I am inspired by how digital services shape the shopping experience for millions of customers across thousands of branches. Contributing to the backend systems that power the dm app and online shop in agile teams aligns closely with my background in enterprise e-commerce platforms and my desire to build robust digital touchpoints.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated to apply my 5+ years of backend Java and microservices experience to help scale dmTECH's digital commerce touchpoints and ensure high system performance.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I applied for the Backend Developer position at dmTECH. With 5+ years of backend experience in Java, Spring Boot, and REST APIs, plus my location in Karlsruhe and availability from Dec 16, 2026, I'd love to connect and discuss how I can contribute.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Backend Developer Onlineshop & dm-App - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the Backend Developer Onlineshop & dm-App position at dmTECH GmbH. With over 5 years of professional experience in backend development, Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful APIs, I am eager to contribute to your digital commerce platforms. My CV and cover letter provide further details on my background in building enterprise systems and data pipelines. I am based in Karlsruhe and available to start on 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
